metadata.title: Density Pass 24 -- Day 2 Overnight Culp's Hill Detail (Ticks 376-450)
metadata.description: Johnson's division holding the captured XII Corps breastworks overnight. Geary's division stripped away by Meade to plug Cemetery Ridge -- leaving the breastworks empty for Johnson to occupy. The XII Corps returning in the dark. Midnight skirmishing. The stage set for the July 3 dawn assault.

placements.notes: Johnson's division in captured XII Corps breastworks -- they hold the right of the Confederate line
Steuart's brigade in the lower works -- closest to the Baltimore Pike
Jones's brigade -- Virginia regiments on Culp's Hill
Nichols's brigade holding the upper works
Geary's XII Corps returning in the dark -- their breastworks are occupied
Williams's XII Corps returning to find Confederates in their positions
Steuart overnight -- he has pushed to the Baltimore Pike area
Geary's division taking position -- they will attack at dawn to reclaim their works
Williams's division in position for the morning assault
Johnson's men sleeping in the Union breastworks -- in a few hours the assault will come
Geary's XII Corps bivouacking -- orders received to retake the works at first light
Williams's division in position -- Greene's brigade has held a sliver of the works all night
Greene's brigade -- the New Yorkers who held through the night. 1400 men vs 4700. They held.
Steuart's brigade at 4 AM -- Geary's artillery about to open
Geary's division advancing in the dark -- the July 3 dawn assault begins
Muhlenberg's artillery massing -- 26 guns about to open on the Culp's Hill works
Williams's XII Corps assault underway -- the end of Day 2 / opening of Day 3
